description: A SIGN clause on a GROUP item that applies to a signed numeric subordinate whose usage is not DISPLAY (kb/Work PB1319). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from both editions' texts (kb/Work PB3965): §1985:VI.5.12.3 SR2 requires 'The numeric data description entries to which the SIGN clause applies must be described, implicitly or explicitly, as USAGE IS DISPLAY'; §2002:13.16.50.2 SR2 (and §2023:13.18.52.3 SR2) restricts only 'an elementary item for which the SIGN clause is specified', and §2023:13.18.52.4 GR1 applies a group's clause to a binary or packed item without effect (CONFORMANCE.md D-SIGN1; VCR row 7.40). A subordinate that writes its own SIGN clause is the subject of that clause (GR2/GR3), so the group's clause does not apply to it or to anything below it. Gated in ONE place, CheckSignClausesPass.
display: a group SIGN clause applying to a signed numeric item whose usage is not DISPLAY
